deepcfr_policy.pth.rules: no free fold (fold only when facing a bet), 100-chip stacks, blinds 1/2, fold / call / min-raise / all-in, 3rd raise -> all-in
deepcfr_policy.pth.algorithm: DeepCFR average-strategy net; features=history (DeepCFR paper bet history), arch=paper, cards=embed, dim 64, uniform RM fallback
deepcfr_policy.pth.advantage_fit: 4000 steps x 16384, Adam 1e-3, from scratch each iteration
deepcfr_policy.pth.memories: reservoir 20M advantage samples per seat, 20M strategy samples

blueprint_nlhe.pt.algorithm: tabular Pluribus-style MCCFR-P blueprint (headsup.blueprint): Linear MCCFR with negative-regret pruning, 169 lossless preflop classes + 200 equal-mass EHS buckets per later round (Monte-Carlo EHS, 500 runouts), 20M iterations; play-only file (average-strategy counters, no regrets)
blueprint_nlhe.pt.note: an equilibrium approximation exploits fixed bots less than the DeepCFR nets do; use it with real-time search: python -m headsup.web --opponent pluribus
blueprint_nlhe.pt.head_to_head: +0.81 +- 0.04 chips/hand vs models/deepcfr_policy.pth, +0.82 +- 0.04 vs its SD-CFR average (300 000 hands each)
